# Anivora 0.1.38 — Reference welcome, startup wheel and clean portrait framing

- Replace the placeholder welcome panels with the four poster artworks shown in the reference, diagonal dividers, a dark gradient and matching welcome/button spacing. Keep Anivora branding, optional sign-in and offline guest access. Artwork is bundled for first launch; no poster network request is required.
- Replace the standard startup spinner with eight tapered green dots. Hold the actual final animation frame, shrink/lift the mark above the wheel and make the short handoff independent of network requests. Respect reduced motion and retain bounded video-error recovery, cached Home and reconnect refresh.
- Re-export all 280 avatars using centred, inset portrait bounds. Exclude neighbouring atlas cells and clip each corrected image to one circle. Keep all stable IDs/aliases and old public files; revision-2 URLs bypass stale image caches. Refresh six local defaults and use one clipped image surface without a fallback portrait underneath it.
- Resolve old HTTPS selections and older catalog caches to the corrected art. Preserve Google/AniList profile photos until the owner explicitly selects an illustrated avatar.
- Preserve downloads/HLS/merge, native playback and Cast/PiP, Profile TV pairing, remote asset hosting, GitHub updates, Cloudflare pages, on-device manga and server notices. The owner dashboard redesign stays on Cloudflare; unprepared social/payment links remain inactive.

Android version code: **40**, newer than 0.1.37/code 39. Package:
`com.brandon300.anivora`. ARM64, Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. The original signing
certificate is retained; install over the existing app without uninstalling.

## Validation and limits

Release gates cover TypeScript/lint, app/backend tests, Expo compatibility, native
unit tests, Android 14 HLS/storage regressions, exact compiled source and local
artwork, package/version/signer inspection and anonymous public APK checksums.
Controlled browser checks exercise the real intro, welcome actions, local art,
offline cache/reconnect, portrait rows and preservation of Google profile photos.
All avatar exports have validated bounds, dimensions and circular alpha masks.

Physical Hot 50i animation/rendering and Chromecast testing remain pending; no
device certification is claimed. Account synchronization and TV pairing still
require an available backend. Cast eligibility and provider restrictions remain.

See [welcome and avatar corrections](welcome-startup-avatars.md),
[startup/offline behavior](startup-and-offline.md), and [0.1.37 notes](releases/0.1.37.md).

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/f400650e1d86d20e55cf7598f0e44c19d92c45e8
